text:
I can't tell you when Raptor first appears in this mail store, or who wrote about it, because I can't search or open the emails from here.

What I can offer is general background on Enron, not anything from these mailboxes:
- The Raptor vehicles (Raptor I through IV) were off-balance-sheet hedging structures set up in 2000. Raptor I and the related Talon entity date to roughly the spring of 2000.
- They are usually linked to Andy Fastow's finance group, LJM2, and Enron's accounting and Arthur Andersen reviews. People often named in connection with them include Fastow, Ben Glisan, Jeff McMahon, Rick Causey and Jeff Skilling.
- The word "Raptor" could appear in the mail before the structures were publicly known, and it could also refer to something unrelated, so these dates are only a guide to where to look.

To find the first mention, search "Raptor" (and "Talon") with a date filter from early 2000 and sort oldest first. Then check the senders on the earliest hits, since the first ones may not be about the hedging vehicles at all.

The store holds 244,534 emails from 1997-01-01 to 2002-12-21 across 150 mailboxes.

You can't search or read the mail here: answer from what you know about it.

Answer in plain words, without headings: a short opening line with the answer, then the evidence as a few sentences or a short list, with dates, names and short quotes. If you don't know, say so plainly instead of guessing.

End with one last line, exactly "Found: yes", "Found: partly" or "Found: no".
